maddeler.e:
نشتكي (form VIII)
# نَشْتَكِي (naštakī) /naʃ.ta.kiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَكَى (ištakā)
# نَشْتَكِيَ (naštakiya) /naʃ.ta.ki.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَكَى (ištakā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
